rounds.text: A calm banking palette should feel steady and trustworthy, so I've built it around a deep primary blue with softer blue-teal support and a near-white surface. The primary tonal range runs from pale to deep so it can cover backgrounds, buttons and emphasis. The text pairings put dark ink on the light surface and white on the primary, and each pairing shows its contrast rating so you can check legibility.
